parent: byte-exact scored E3; original coordinates retained
mechanism: Fit rank-Gaussian LedoitWolf partial correlations on independent E7.25 single cells; within each parent state blend conditional/original ranks equally, then permute existing values separately per gene. Transfer dependence, never expression units.
external_source: GSE278981/GSM8559288 independent E7.25 PE725 10x filtered count matrix only
panel_alignment: 498 official genes, explicit aggregation of same-symbol feature counts; no missing gene filled
disclosure: External data: NCBI GEO GSE278981, sample GSM8559288, independently processed E7.25 mouse embryo 10x single-cell RNA-seq PE725 filtered count files only. Only E7.25 sample-specific barcodes/features/matrix downloaded and used; no E7.5 files or jointly trained atlas/embedding/labels from that series used. Source counts supply gene rank dependence, not absolute expression or proportions. No pretrained models. Carrier and geometry use official released E6.75/E7.25/E8.0 Task 2 data.
license: GEO open reuse policy; not asserted CC-BY/CC0
limitations: Internal covariance control outperforms external covariance locally; no claim external is best.
External E7.25 is an independent dataset but same stage as official pseudo-target, so this local fold is not strict all-source stage holdout.
Different platform/detection/strain may bias dependence; ranks avoid UMI units but do not eliminate domain mismatch.
MMD and variogram depend on joint gene structure and can change despite fixed marginals. DE estimates use finite sampling; no guarantee all server metrics stay numerically exact.
budget: overall third planned submission, external first of two; unsubmitted at freeze

reproducibility_environment.cross_thread_bit_exact: NOT_GUARANTEED; rank ties can change under different BLAS reduction order

two_thread_comparison.interpretation: Small floating reduction changes can cause discrete rank reassignment. Do not describe all value differences as tiny. Same locked single-thread environment independently reproduces exactly.
